text: To prove φ → ψ by →-introduction in natural deduction, one:
choices: proves φ and proves ψ separately, then pairs them
assumes φ as a hypothesis, derives ψ, then discharges the assumption of φ
applies modus ponens to φ and ψ
explanation: →-introduction assumes the antecedent φ, derives ψ under that assumption, then DISCHARGES (cancels) the hypothesis to conclude φ → ψ. Option 1 describes ∧-introduction, option 2 describes ¬-introduction, and option 4 misapplies modus ponens (which is an elimination, not introduction, rule).
